registryBuildBlockerCarriedForwardNotUse.butItIsSubstantive: It is worth counsel's attention precisely because it is visible on the face of these sources: CIV_EXP_02_A is captioned to § 4374 while this track files under § 4375, and Delaware publishes a separate after-pardon order (CIV_EXP_08_A). rows.whatWouldUnblockIt: A decision by the Captain and counsel on one of: (a) re-binding this family to unencrypted originals obtained from Delaware Courts, with new digests recorded in the registry, the manifest, the queue and a fresh acquisition receipt; or (b) adding a decryption-capable PDF engine to the factory (qpdf and mutool are not installed in this container; poppler's pdftotext and pdfinfo are, and they read these files, so the bytes are not damaged — only pdf-lib cannot open them), together with an explicit ruling that a factory-decrypted derivative may stand in for a court's published bytes. Neither is a build decision.
rows.whyEveryCounterIsNull: Nothing was built, so there is nothing to count. No fixture PDF, field map, field census, write report or blanks report exists for this family, and a zero in any of these nine would be a measurement this lane did not take. Zero writes is not the same fact as zero defects.
rows.measuredEncryptionDefect: Every Delaware Courts expungement instrument this family binds is published as an AES-256 encrypted PDF (pdfinfo: 'Encrypted: yes (print:yes copy:no change:no addNotes:yes algorithm:AES-256)'). pdf-lib 1.17.1, which is the only PDF engine any official_pdf_fill builder in this factory uses, carries no security handler at all: its parser reads /Encrypt into trailerInfo (node_modules/pdf-lib/cjs/core/parser/PDFParser.js:266) and never decrypts. `ignoreEncryption: true`, which every finalize path passes, suppresses the EncryptedPDFError throw and then parses ciphertext as though it were plaintext, which is why the failure surfaces as object-graph corruption rather than as an encryption error.
rows.howTheRefusalWasMeasured: Measured through the factory's own entry points, not inferred from the file header. Both PDFDocument.load(bytes, { ignoreEncryption: true, updateMetadata: false }) and finalizeFlatOverlay() from scripts/rcap-official-forms/rcap-official-form-finalize.mjs were called on the exact bound bytes. Control in the same run: the North Carolina AOC-CR-288 binary that the COMPLETE_PACKET_PROVEN nc_146_acquittal_petition-set builds from (sha256 776210116d1ee07a...), which is unencrypted, loaded and censused 128 AcroForm fields and 135 text items on the same code path in the same process.
rows.factoryPrecedentChecked: 186 distinct official documents are bound by exact SHA-256 across every source-receipt.json under data/rcap-all50/overlays/census-v1. Of the 34 that resolve to bytes on disk in this container, 33 are unencrypted and 0 are encrypted. This factory has never built an official_pdf_fill packet from an encrypted source, and holds no code path that could.
rows.noUnencryptedCopyExists: Every PDF under the mounted Delaware custody was hashed and probed. All four court-published instruments are AES-256 encrypted, as is CIV_EXP_06_A. The only two unencrypted Delaware PDFs in custody are FORM-1021IP (an instruction packet) and Delaware-RecordExpungement-Agent-Reference.pdf (an internal training reference); neither is a filing instrument and neither is bound by any of these families. The Master Library holds no Delaware CIV_EXP form PDF at all.
rows.whatWasNotDone: The source was not decrypted, re-saved, rasterized, print-to-PDF'd, reconstructed or substituted, and no builder script was written for this family. Decrypting would produce bytes with a different SHA-256 than the digest the track registry, the packet-set manifest, MASTER_QUEUE.json and the acquisition receipt all bind, so the packet handed to a participant would not be the instrument any controlling record names; it would also mean stripping a court's own change:no permission from its published form. Both are re-binding decisions for the Captain and counsel, not a build, and neither was taken here.
rows.whyNoBuilderScriptWasWritten: scripts/build-census-v1-de_pardon_expungement-set.mjs, scripts/build-census-v1-de_discretionary_superior_court-set.mjs and scripts/build-census-v1-de_discretionary_family_court-set.mjs were NOT created. A builder that cannot open its own sources cannot be run, cannot be tested and produces nothing, and committing three of them would leave scripts that read as an official_pdf_fill path for Delaware while being none. buildScriptExists stays false for all three, which is what SOURCE_READY_BUILDABILITY.json already records.
rows.sourceRecoveryWasNecessaryButNotSufficie: The 2026-09-04 acquisition archive was correctly recovered and correctly mounted, and this lane re-hashed all four Delaware originals and confirmed each against SOURCE_REMATERIALIZATION_REQUEST.json's expectedSha256 and expectedByteLength. The missing-bytes input is genuinely discharged. It was not, however, the only blocker: these three families would have stopped on the encrypted-source defect on 2026-09-04 as well.
rows.verdictIssued: none. This lane builds and stops; it verifies nothing and approves nothing.

rows.implementationStrategy: official_pdf_fill (declared). Measured: this family binds no PDF at all.
rows.exactRefusal: No refusal from pdf-lib, because neither bound instrument is a PDF and neither was ever offered to it. FORM-281 is 'Composite Document File V2 Document, Little Endian, Os: Windows, Version 10.0, Code page: 1252, Title: The Family Court of the State of Delaware, Author: Morett, William (Courts), Name of Creating Application: Microsoft Office Word, Number of Pages: 1, Number of Words: 574' — a binary Word .doc. FORM-281E is 'Microsoft Word 2007+', an Office Open XML .docx whose word/document.xml carries legacy Word form fields (FORMTEXT and FORMCHECKBOX runs). The declared strategy for this family, in the track registry, the packet-set manifest, MASTER_QUEUE.json and SOURCE_READY_BUILDABILITY.json alike, is official_pdf_fill.

rows.itIsNotJustTheDotDoc: The assignment named one format problem, FORM-281 being a .doc. There are two. The conditional continuation FORM-281E is a .docx, held byte-exact in the Master Library at aaca121e3bb4ce51ab9ab4ff6d933138bf7a36b6d97269c02cbf3c0290e87b33 and confirmed here. Delaware Family Court publishes this whole packet family as Word documents, so this family binds no PDF whatsoever. A one-off conversion of the .doc would not have produced a buildable family either.

theThreeHonestOptionsAndWhichWasTaken.optionConsidered1: Build a Word path if the factory has one.
theThreeHonestOptionsAndWhichWasTaken.verdictOn1: The factory has none, and this was measured rather than assumed. All 186 official-document bindings across every source-receipt.json under data/rcap-all50/overlays/census-v1 are PDFs; every one of the 186 build-census-v1 builders that touches a source binary imports pdf-lib and goes through finalizeOfficialForm or finalizeFlatOverlay, both of which begin with PDFDocument.load. There is no docx or doc fill engine, no Word-aware completeness contract, and no docx branch in scripts/rcap-packet-completeness/. The two required output-byte glyph readings, addedGlyphsReadFromOutputBytes and nonWhitespaceGlyphsOutsideMeasuredWriteBoxes, are defined as measurements over a produced PDF's content streams and have no meaning over a .doc. Writing such a path would be building new shared factory infrastructure, which is not this lane's grant and is not a packet build.
theThreeHonestOptionsAndWhichWasTaken.optionConsidered2: Stop with BLOCKED_SOURCE naming the format problem exactly.
theThreeHonestOptionsAndWhichWasTaken.optionConsidered3: Report that it needs a docx path and stop.
theThreeHonestOptionsAndWhichWasTaken.taken: Options 2 and 3 together. This row is the BLOCKED_SOURCE stop naming both formats exactly, and the lane return to the assigning agent states that this family needs a Word path decision before it can be built at all.
theThreeHonestOptionsAndWhichWasTaken.theDishonestOptionAndWhyItWasRefused: Converting silently and presenting the result as the official form. It was refused, and it is worth being explicit that it was refused as a choice rather than prevented by the container: LibreOffice IS installed here (/usr/bin/soffice, /usr/bin/libreoffice), so `soffice --convert-to pdf` would have produced a plausible PDF within seconds. What it would have produced is a LibreOffice re-render — its pagination, its font substitution, its line breaks — bearing no relation to any digest in any controlling record, and handing it to a participant as the Delaware Family Court petition would be presenting this factory's output as a court's published instrument. SOURCE_REMATERIALIZATION_REQUEST.json's own noteOnFormat anticipates exactly this: 'DE-FORM-281 is a .doc, not a PDF. It was not converted. Whoever builds de_discretionary_family_court-set needs a Word path or a stop, not a silent conversion.' SOURCE_READY_BUILDABILITY.json rules the same way on the sibling: 'The bytes are held and hash exactly, and they are not a PDF. An official_pdf_fill route cannot overlay them; converting or acquiring a PDF is somebody's decision, not a build.'
theThreeHonestOptionsAndWhichWasTaken.nothingWasConverted: No conversion of any kind was run. soffice was never invoked. The two Word files were opened read-only to establish their format and field structure and were not written, copied or transformed.

recordsDefectWorthCorrecting.what: Four records declare implementationStrategy / outputStrategy official_pdf_fill for this family and for both of its official components: legal-design-track-registry.json (trackId de_discretionary_family_court), legal-design-packet-set-manifests.json (de_discretionary_family_court-set v1.0.0), MASTER_QUEUE.json, and SOURCE_READY_BUILDABILITY.json.
recordsDefectWorthCorrecting.why: No component of this family is a PDF, so official_pdf_fill cannot be the right strategy for it under any engine. The declaration is wrong on its face, independently of whether the factory ever gains a Word path.
recordsDefectWorthCorrecting.notEdited: No controlling record and no central manifest was opened for writing by this lane. Correcting a strategy declaration is a Captain decision.
recordsDefectWorthCorrecting.alreadyPartlyObserved: SOURCE_READY_BUILDABILITY.json classifies FORM-281E as 'held_but_not_a_pdf' and already says an official_pdf_fill route cannot overlay it, so the contradiction is visible in the measurement record; what is new here is that it applies to the primary filing too, and therefore to the whole family.

rows.whatWouldUnblockIt: A Captain-and-counsel decision on one of three, none of which is a build: (a) give the factory a Word fill path — one that fills the court's own FORMTEXT and FORMCHECKBOX fields and preserves the court's layout — together with a completeness contract and glyph-reading equivalents that work over Word output, and change this family's declared strategy accordingly; (b) acquire genuine PDF originals of FORM-281 and FORM-281E from Delaware Family Court and re-bind the family to those digests; or (c) rule explicitly that a factory-converted PDF may stand in for a court's published Word instrument, and record that ruling where a reviewer will see it. Note for (b): Delaware's Superior Court forms ARE published as PDFs and are still unbuildable, because they are AES-256 encrypted — see the other two rows in this file. Acquiring PDFs for Family Court may substitute this family's blocker for that one rather than remove it.
